speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Morning, both of you. Okay, I've got the Ducal call at ten thirty, so let's keep this tight. Tybalt, you want to start?

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: Sure. So, good news. The Android 11 crash is fixed.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Wait, really? Already?

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: Yeah. It was the photo cache. On older Android we were writing thumbnails to a cache path that, um, the system can clear out from under us. So the app goes to read a photo it just took, the file's gone, and it falls over.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Huh. So it wasn't the camera at all.

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: Nope. Camera's fine. I moved the cache into app storage and added a check so a missing thumbnail just gets regenerated instead of crashing. Both of the crash reports reproduce on my test phone before the fix, and neither one does after.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: That's great. Thank you. Is it in the beta build yet?

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: It'll be in tonight's build. I'll ping the two testers who reported it and ask them to update.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Perfect. Angela, where are we on the checklist?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: So the release checklist is about eighty percent done. Store listing, screenshots, the release notes you wrote yesterday, the rollback plan, all of that's checked off.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: And the other twenty?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Mostly QA. I need a sign-off from Balthasar, and he won't give it until he's rerun the offline-sync tests with his fix in. Which, honestly, is the right call.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Agreed. Do you think we'll have that before Friday?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: I think so. I'm going to grab him tomorrow afternoon and go through it together. If anything's shaky, I'll tell you before the go or no-go, not during it.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Thank you. Friday nine thirty still works for everyone?

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: Works for me.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: It's on the calendar.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Okay. One more thing from me. Tybalt, your worry from Monday, about Schema Bridge depending on Mesh Routing being up?

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: Still worried, yeah.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: So I brought it up with Romeo in the kickoff, and he's building a local queue on our side. If Mesh Routing goes down, Balcony just keeps working. Inspections pile up in the queue on the device and send when the service is back. Nobody in the field even notices.

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: Okay. That's, um, that's actually the right answer.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Don't sound so surprised.

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: I'm not. Okay, a little. Look, if it survives a week of airplane mode, I'm satisfied.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Can I write that down? Tybalt, satisfied.

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: Conditionally satisfied. Write the condition down too.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Fair. I'm meeting with Romeo at three, he's supposed to show me the prototype. I'll tell you how it holds up.

speaker: Tybalt Capulet
text: Sounds good.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Okay, that's it. Thanks, both of you. Go do good things.
